name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v538: Complete Cloudflare bypass rewrite. (1) Invisible Cloudflare WebView uses CloudStream's proven attach pattern - full-size alpha=0 container at index 0 of window root, touch passthrough, focus blocked - no challenge page overlaps the CineAnime home on TV. (2) isUsableClearance accepts existing cf_clearance once page loads past challenge - cookies actually save and Settings shows Saved. (3) Poll timeout cut from 120s to 30s - fail fast instead of spinning for 2 minutes. (4) Both visible and headless WebViews use same cleaned User-Agent that Cloudflare accepts. (5) WebView settings restored for Cloudflare Turnstile (multiple windows, mixed content, file access, images). (6) Always require cf_clearance before marking solve successful. (7) Removed dead JS cookie probe. (8) Clear in-flight bypass on dismiss. (9) init() runs in background - no app-start freeze. (10) Clear all cookies deletes Domain=.host jar variants. Kwik and Pahe extractors temporarily disabled - will be re-enabled once their invoke functions are implemented.
